scenario.name: plan_conflicts
scenario.description: Multiple plans trying to modify the same components

detection.sign: Conflicting changes to the same files

resolution.step: Identify all affected plans and their scope
Update dependencies to reflect the order

prevention.rule: Always check existing plans before creating new ones
Use the coordination section to communicate with other teams

scenario.name: incomplete_plan_structure
scenario.description: Plan missing required sections according to navigation rules

resolution.step: Identify which required sections are missing
Fill in the missing sections following the template

prevention.rule: Review navigation rules before creating plans

scenario.name: architectural_invariant_violation
scenario.description: Plan proposes changes that violate architectural invariants

resolution.step: Identify which invariants are being violated
Update the plan to follow proper architecture

prevention.rule: Consult with architecture team if uncertain

validation_checklist.item: Does the plan follow the standard template?
Does the plan respect architectural invariants?
Are entry points specific and accurate?
Is the coordination section updated for parallel work?

procedure.name: rollback_plan
procedure.description: Steps to take when a plan needs to be abandoned or reversed

steps.step: Document why the plan is being rolled back
Identify what work has already been done
Update the plan status to reflect current state
Update dependencies that may be affected

procedure.name: plan_revision
procedure.description: Steps to update a plan when requirements change

steps.step: Update the Purpose and Scope sections
Revise the Planned Changes with new checkboxes
Update Entry Points if scope changed
Revise Test Coverage if functionality changed
Update Obsolete section for new considerations
Update the coordination section for parallel work
